provenance.motivation: V5 terminated at calibration because its two inherited V4 anchors were too easy. Independent review also identified selector scars and simple tasks.
provenance.non_adaptation_commitment: The six-task V6 evaluation roster and endpoint are fixed now; no V5 evaluation outcomes exist and no V6 outcome may alter them.
provenance.anchor_reuse_interpretation: The three calibration anchors are independently rematerialized and re-invoked as the first three evaluation tasks with no conversation, workspace, feedback, or heldout-outcome carry-over. Because evaluation execution is conditional on baseline calibration failure on these same tasks, V6 is exploratory and conditional on its gate, not an independent confirmatory or generalizable efficacy estimate.

calibration_rule.admit: All three invocations and heldout reference/guard checks are valid, all guards pass, and at least two of three anchors do not recover the target.
calibration_rule.ceiling_abort: With otherwise valid accounting and guards, two or three anchors recover the target; execute zero evaluation cells.
calibration_rule.invalid: Any invocation, heldout result, target accounting, guard accounting, or guard result is invalid.

quota_rule.admit_if: projected_usage <= 76 and every pre-cell reduced usage < 76
quota_rule.on_failure: Stop before the next provider call and classify as provider/quota limitation.

cell_contract.materialization: Copy the qualified V5/V5.2 native reference, compile the selected defect through AST partial evaluation, remove selectors/check IDs/literal boolean branches, and rename the atomic implementation cue.
cell_contract.start: A and B are byte-identical clones of one source-native controlled defect.
cell_contract.A-baseline: Public SPEC and claims template only.
cell_contract.B-agentharness: Same public inputs plus one immutable opaque V6 review finding.
cell_contract.heldout_timing: Evaluate both cells only after both repairs in the block have completed.

primary_endpoint: Per-task paired binary success: target check passes and every sibling/common guard passes.

decision_rule.GO: B>A on at least 5 of 6 tasks, A>B on zero tasks, B target recovery on at least 5 of 6 tasks, and zero B guard regressions.
decision_rule.NO-GO: A valid complete study that does not satisfy every GO condition.
decision_rule.INVALID: Incomplete roster, invalid accounting/evaluation, treatment contamination, or integrity failure.

secondary_report: Descriptive only: paired differences, mean paired delta, A recovery, B recovery, and guard outcomes; it cannot override the primary decision.
